address: Paseo Kanai 14, Solidaridad, Playa del Carmen, 77730, Mexico
bio: Located inside the stylish and meticulously groomed The Riviera Maya EDITION at Kanai, this breezy oasis features verdant views as well as pools of water that flow gently alongside the restaurant and all through the property. Sourcing ingredients from across Mexico, the kitchen delivers familiar dishes with unexpected inspiration. Tlayudas arrive smeared in artichoke puree and topped with tuna and Serrano peppers. Lamb is charred to the hilt and paired with guacamole garnished with pistachios and cocoa nibs. A dark chocolate tamale sings with passion fruit sorbet and crispy hoja Santa. Friendly, attentive servers dressed in crisp whites keep close watch over the spacious dining room fit with a cocktail bar in the center....
